# CookieFirst

Cookie consent management platform (CMP) for GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA, LGPD, Law 25, and PDPA compliance. Google Certified CMP offering automated cookie scanning, consent banners, policy generation in 40+ languages, and Google Consent Mode v2 integration.

CookieFirst is a consent management platform that helps websites comply with international privacy regulations by managing cookie consent, blocking third-party scripts before consent, and providing automated compliance tools for businesses of all sizes.

## Product & Features

[Cookie Consent Manager](https://cookiefirst.com): Main product overview and capabilities[Platform Features](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-consent-manager-features/): Detailed feature breakdown including third-party script management, consent audit trails, cross-domain consent, and re-consent optimization[Cookie Banner](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-banner/): Customizable GDPR-compliant cookie banners[Cookie Scanner](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-scanner/): Automated monthly cookie and local storage scanning[Cookie Policy Generator](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-policy-generator/): Automated policy generation in 40+ languages[Consent Management Platform](https://cookiefirst.com/consent-management-platform/): Comprehensive consent management capabilities[Google Consent Mode](https://cookiefirst.com/google-consent-mode/): Google Certified CMP with Consent Mode v2 integration

## Pricing & Plans

[Pricing](https://cookiefirst.com/#pricing): Free plan available, paid plans start at €9/month (Basic) and €19/month (Plus), with enterprise options[Reseller/Affiliate Model](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-consent-reseller/): 30% commission for agencies and resellers

## Privacy Regulations & Compliance

[GDPR (Europe)](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-consent-gdpr/): European General Data Protection Regulation compliance[ePrivacy Regulation (Europe)](https://cookiefirst.com/eprivacy-regulation/): EU ePrivacy directive compliance[CCPA (US)](https://cookiefirst.com/ccpa-compliance/): California Consumer Privacy Act compliance[LGPD (Brazil)](https://cookiefirst.com/lgpd-brazil/): Brazilian data protection law compliance[PIPEDA & CPPA (Canada)](https://cookiefirst.com/pipeda-cppa-cookie-consent-canada/): Canadian privacy compliance[Law 25 (Quebec, Canada)](https://cookiefirst.com/law-25-quebec-and-cookie-consent/): Quebec privacy law with mandatory cookie banners (effective Sept 22, 2023)[PDPA (Thailand)](https://cookiefirst.com/pdpa-thailand-and-cookies/): Thai data protection compliance

## Platform Integrations

[WordPress](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-consent-plugins-integrations/): Plugin available for easy WordPress integration[Shopify](https://cookiefirst.com/shopify-cookies-consent/): Shopify integration guide[Shopware](https://cookiefirst.com/cookie-consent-plugins-integrations/): Shopware plugin[WooCommerce](https://cookiefirst.com/woocommerce-cookies-consent/): WooCommerce integration[Magento/Adobe Commerce](https://cookiefirst.com/magento-cookies-consent-adobe-commerce/): Magento integration[Typo3](https://cookiefirst.com/typo3-cookie-consent/): Typo3 CMS integration[Drupal](https://cookiefirst.com/drupal-cookies-consent/): Drupal integration[Joomla](https://cookiefirst.com/joomla-cookies-consent/): Joomla integration[Prestashop](https://cookiefirst.com/prestashop-cookies-consent/): Prestashop integration[HubSpot](https://cookiefirst.com/hubspot-cookies-consent/): HubSpot integration[Wix](https://cookiefirst.com/wix-cookies-consent/): Wix integration

## Competitors & Alternatives

CookieFirst positions itself as an alternative to Cookiebot, Usercentrics, CookiePro, Illow, Borlabs Cookie, Axeptio, CookieYes, and Osano.

## Documentation & Support

[Support Center](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us): Complete documentation and help center[Implementation Guide](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us/articles/13646811703069-Implementation-Guide): Getting started with CookieFirst implementation[Installation & Configuration](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001366738-Installation-and-Configuration): Setup guides for various platforms[Google Tag Manager & Consent Mode](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us): GTM integration and Google Consent Mode v2 setup[JavaScript API Documentation](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011568738-Cookie-Banner-Public-API-documentation): Public API for programmatic control[Advanced Features](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002134718-Advanced-features): Advanced configuration options[General FAQ](https://support.cookiefirst.com/hc/en-us/sections/360002315598-General-FAQ): Frequently asked questions

## Blog & Resources

[Blog](https://cookiefirst.com/articles/): Privacy regulation updates, feature announcements, and compliance guides[Service Status](https://status.cookiefirst.com): Platform uptime and status monitoring


## Key Information

**Company**: Digital Data Solutions BV**Location**: Netherlands**Languages Supported**: 40+ languages including English, German, Portuguese, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish, Czech**Certifications**: Google Certified CMP, IAB TCF 2.2 supported**Trial**: 14-day free trial available for paid plans**Free Plan**: Available with limited features (1 third-party script, one-time cookie scan)

## Contact

[Contact Page](https://cookiefirst.com/info-about-cookie-consent/): Get in touch with CookieFirst team[Sign Up/Free Trial](https://app.cookiefirst.com/register): Create account and start trial[Login](https://app.cookiefirst.com/login): Access existing account

<!-- Remove cookies after withdrawal -->
	<script>
	(function () {
  window.cf_delete_cookie =
    window.cf_delete_cookie ||
    function (cookie) {
      var name = cookie.unmasked_name || cookie.name;
      var path = cookie.path || "/";
      var domain = cookie.host_key || "";
      //console.log("cookie for removal", { name });
      document.cookie = `${name}= ; expires = Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path= ${path}; domain=${domain};`;
      if (window.localStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
      if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.sessionStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
    };

  function remove_cookies(consent = {}) {
    if (typeof consent !== "object") {
      throw new Error("Uknnown error");
    }

    window.CookieFirst.fetchLatestScan()
      .then(function (result) {
        if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.cookies)) {
          return;
        }

        result.cookies.forEach(function (cookie) {
          // category accepted or cookie is http_only
          if (consent[cookie.cat] || cookie.http_only) {
            return;
          }

          window.cf_delete_cookie(cookie);
        });
      })
      .catch(console.log);
  }

  function handle_consent_event(e) {
    var consent = e.detail || { necessary: true };
    if (!window.CookieFirst) {
      window.addEventListener("cf_init", function () {
        remove_cookies(consent);
      });
      return;
    }

    remove_cookies(consent);
  }

  window.addEventListener("cf_consent", handle_consent_event);
  window.addEventListener("cf_consent_loaded", handle_consent_event);
})();
	</script>
<!-- End of helper script to remove cookies -->

<!-- Remove cookies after withdrawal -->
	<script>
	(function () {
  window.cf_delete_cookie =
    window.cf_delete_cookie ||
    function (cookie) {
      var name = cookie.unmasked_name || cookie.name;
      var path = cookie.path || "/";
      var domain = cookie.host_key || "";
      //console.log("cookie for removal", { name });
      document.cookie = `${name}= ; expires = Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path= ${path}; domain=${domain};`;
      if (window.localStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
      if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.sessionStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
    };

  function remove_cookies(consent = {}) {
    if (typeof consent !== "object") {
      throw new Error("Uknnown error");
    }

    window.CookieFirst.fetchLatestScan()
      .then(function (result) {
        if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.cookies)) {
          return;
        }

        result.cookies.forEach(function (cookie) {
          // category accepted or cookie is http_only
          if (consent[cookie.cat] || cookie.http_only) {
            return;
          }

          window.cf_delete_cookie(cookie);
        });
      })
      .catch(console.log);
  }

  function handle_consent_event(e) {
    var consent = e.detail || { necessary: true };
    if (!window.CookieFirst) {
      window.addEventListener("cf_init", function () {
        remove_cookies(consent);
      });
      return;
    }

    remove_cookies(consent);
  }

  window.addEventListener("cf_consent", handle_consent_event);
  window.addEventListener("cf_consent_loaded", handle_consent_event);
})();
	</script>

			<div class="wpb_wrapper">
				<div class="toggles accordion" data-br="" data-starting="default" data-style="minimal"><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>What are cookies?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>Cookies are text files with tiny pieces of information. This data can be used for many different purposes. An example of this type of data are login details like a username and password combination. Internet cookies can be very useful for browsing the internet. Apart from remembering which sites an internet user has visited, cookies also form information to make browsing and filling in digital forms more quickly and efficiently. Without cookies, navigation on websites would be less convenient and interactive for users.</p>
<p>Read more about cookies in our article ‘<a href="https://cookiefirst.com/what-are-cookies/">What are cookies?</a>‘</p>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>What does CookieFirst do?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>We provide GDPR, LGPD and CCPA compliant cookie banners and consent managing solutions for websites. In a few minutes you can set up a compliant cookie banner and policy for your website and rebrand it in your favourite styles. Stop worrying about your website’s compliance to the GDPR and the CCPA we handle that for you. Simply select the third party services you use, upload our scripts to your website et voila.</p>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>What is the GDPR legislation?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>The General Data Protection Regulation is in effect since the 25th of May 2018. Later this year (2019) the ePrivacy act will be in play as well. These two regulations are meant to guarantee and protect the personal data privacy of EU citizens.</p>
<p>Among other things this legislation means that website owners need to be fully aware of the cookies and third party tracking technology used on their website.</p>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>What is the CCPA?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>Since May last year, we have all been familiar with the European GDPR legislation. But also in the US people are getting ready for privacy protection laws. In 2020, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) will become effective, a bill that protects the privacy rights of consumers in the US state. CCPA and GDPR not only have a sounding abbreviation in common, both laws are extraterritorial and, in other words, also valid outside their own territory. (E-mail) marketers should therefore be better prepared for the arrival of CCPA. We have ten simple tips and advice about cookie consent management which will help you on your way with CCPA Compliance.</p>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>Does my website need a cookie notice and policy?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>Most of the websites need a cookie banner and policy. In short if you use any of the following your website probably needs a compliant cookie banner and policy:</p>
<ul>
<li>Social media buttons</li>
<li>Youtube videos or other third party video embeds</li>
<li>Remarketing</li>
<li>Goal tracking in Adwords, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter and others</li>
<li>Advertising</li>
<li>A/B Testing for marketing purposes.</li>
</ul>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>Is a cookie notice and policy only needed for EU websites?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>The GDPR applies not only to EU websites but to all organisations websites who serve users from the EU or monitor the behaviour of EU data subjects. So whatever the location of your business, if your website processes data from subjects residing in the European Union you’ll have to comply with the GDPR regulation.</p>
	</div>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle default" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" class="toggle-heading"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>Do you need a cookie banner under Law 25 in Quebec?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
	<div class="wpb_wrapper">
		<p>Effective September 22, 2023, Quebec’s privacy landscape is set for a transformative shift with the enactment of the second set of amendments from Law 25. Of these new changes, one stands out markedly: the mandatory implementation of cookie banners. Any organization operating within Quebec must now transparently disclose their use of technologies like non-essential cookies that identify, locate, or profile users. The emphasis is on clear user consent, necessitating that cookie consent tools be set up, ensuring tracking technologies are inactive by default. In essence, user privacy is paramount, and organizations are urged to adapt promptly. Given the steep penalties for non-compliance, including potential fines amounting to millions, the significance of these changes—especially the importance of cookie banners—cannot be overstated. Read more about the <a href="https://cookiefirst.com/law-25-quebec-and-cookie-consent/">impact of Law 25 for your organization</a> here.</p>

	<script>
	(function () {
  window.cf_delete_cookie =
    window.cf_delete_cookie ||
    function (cookie) {
      var name = cookie.unmasked_name || cookie.name;
      var path = cookie.path || "/";
      var domain = cookie.host_key || "";
      //console.log("cookie for removal", { name });
      document.cookie = `${name}= ; expires = Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path= ${path}; domain=${domain};`;
      if (window.localStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
      if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.sessionStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
    };

  function remove_cookies(consent = {}) {
    if (typeof consent !== "object") {
      throw new Error("Uknnown error");
    }

    window.CookieFirst.fetchLatestScan()
      .then(function (result) {
        if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.cookies)) {
          return;
        }

        result.cookies.forEach(function (cookie) {
          // category accepted or cookie is http_only
          if (consent[cookie.cat] || cookie.http_only) {
            return;
          }

          window.cf_delete_cookie(cookie);
        });
      })
      .catch(console.log);
  }

  function handle_consent_event(e) {
    var consent = e.detail || { necessary: true };
    if (!window.CookieFirst) {
      window.addEventListener("cf_init", function () {
        remove_cookies(consent);
      });
      return;
    }

    remove_cookies(consent);
  }

  window.addEventListener("cf_consent", handle_consent_event);
  window.addEventListener("cf_consent_loaded", handle_consent_event);
})();
	</script>

<!-- Remove cookies after withdrawal -->
	<script>
	(function () {
  window.cf_delete_cookie =
    window.cf_delete_cookie ||
    function (cookie) {
      var name = cookie.unmasked_name || cookie.name;
      var path = cookie.path || "/";
      var domain = cookie.host_key || "";
      //console.log("cookie for removal", { name });
      document.cookie = `${name}= ; expires = Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path= ${path}; domain=${domain};`;
      if (window.localStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
      if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(name)) {
        window.sessionStorage.removeItem(name);
      }
    };

  function remove_cookies(consent = {}) {
    if (typeof consent !== "object") {
      throw new Error("Uknnown error");
    }

    window.CookieFirst.fetchLatestScan()
      .then(function (result) {
        if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.cookies)) {
          return;
        }

        result.cookies.forEach(function (cookie) {
          // category accepted or cookie is http_only
          if (consent[cookie.cat] || cookie.http_only) {
            return;
          }

          window.cf_delete_cookie(cookie);
        });
      })
      .catch(console.log);
  }

  function handle_consent_event(e) {
    var consent = e.detail || { necessary: true };
    if (!window.CookieFirst) {
      window.addEventListener("cf_init", function () {
        remove_cookies(consent);
      });
      return;
    }

    remove_cookies(consent);
